errorCodes.meaning: The install token is missing, malformed, expired, or already consumed.
The registrationId does not match an open registration for this token.

The WebAuthn registration failed verification — its client data is not a `webauthn.create` over this registration's challenge and the community's origin, its authenticator data is not for the community's RP ID, its attestation statement does not verify, or its credential public key is malformed.

`webauthnAssertion` does not prove possession of the registered key: it is not a `webauthn.get` over the assertion challenge vtc/install/claim/passkey/start issued for this registration and the community's origin, it names another credential, its authenticator data is not for the community's RP ID or lacks user presence, or its signature does not verify under the registered public key. Nothing was consumed and no administrator was written. The assertion challenge is spent: start again.

The registered credential's public key is neither EdDSA over Ed25519 (COSE alg -8, OKP crv 6) nor ES256 over P-256 (COSE alg -7, EC2 crv 1), so no did:key this task defines can name it. Nothing was consumed: register a passkey with one of the two (start offers only those) and finish again.

schema.description: Complete first-administrator enrolment with a passkey: submit the WebAuthn registration and one assertion proving possession of the registered key, from whose credential public key — Ed25519 or P-256 — the administrator's did:key is derived, and receive a setup-session token. The passkey ceremony of vtc/install/claim/finish 0.2, widened from Ed25519 alone to P-256. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

installToken.description: The install JWT the claim was started with.

webauthnAssertion.description: PublicKeyCredential from navigator.credentials.get() (opaque here): one assertion by the credential just registered, over the assertion challenge vtc/install/claim/passkey/start issued. Verified against the key the administrator's DID is derived from; it is the proof of possession, whatever the registration's attestation format.

webauthnResponse.description: RegisterPublicKeyCredential from navigator.credentials.create() (opaque here). Its credential public key is a COSE key for EdDSA/Ed25519 (alg -8) or ES256/P-256 (alg -7); any other is refused with unsupportedAlgorithm.
